data.name: Blind Descent
data.detailed_description:
Blind Descent is an open-world survival adventure that delves into the unknown realms of the Martian depths. A team of up to four pioneers has been sent for a reconnaissance mission, but what was supposed to be a routine expedition has become a fight for human survival. As exploration begins, the subterranean world reveals itself as a living, reactive ecosystem. What follows is a journey deep beneath the Martian surface, where survival hinges on your ability to learn, adapt, and symbiotize.

1. You are an outsider in a mesmerizing and deadly world: Conduct reconnaissance and find clues about the missing pioneer team as you delve into the Martian depths. With the help of your AI assistant, explore a living ecosystem that challenges you to grow into it, adapt, and ultimately understand its intricate balance. Every step you take reveals more alien secrets, leaving you with a choice: use science to enhance your adaptability and stay human, or embrace an ever more symbiotic existence.

2. Use versatile crafting techniques to survive: Scan and study the lifeforms around you to gather resources and craft essential tools. Observing how alien creatures interact with their environment can lead to powerful insights. Every crafted item connects you further to the rich, biodiverse alien world, transforming survival into a path towards integration.

3. Build a reliable shelter as a basis for exploration: Along your journey into the Martian depths, you will discover the lost team's abandoned base. Clear it, make it yours, and improve it to protect yourself from the planet's many hazards and lifeforms. But beware: vines, fungal growths, and creeping alien organisms are quick to react to neglect and will soon overtake any poorly maintained structures. Your base acts as your starting point for both exploration and learning to coexist with an ecosystem that has its own will.

4. Adapt to alien and unusual environmental hazards and biomes: Face ever-changing threats like underground storms, toxic gases, and aggressive creatures. Success depends on observing and learning. Sometimes symbiosis means turning these hazards into survival strategies.

5. Choose your path to adaptation: You are an explorer, and it is up to you to decide how best to survive in an unknown alien environment. Take a scientific approach by crafting tools and equipment that help you and your team endure while preserving your humanity; or become part of the ecosystem by undergoing mutations that enhance your abilities and open up an entirely different way of existing in this world. Science or symbiosis—the choice is yours.

6. Survive as a team: Collaborate with up to three pioneers to gather resources, build shelters, and explore the underground world together. Symbiosis extends to teamwork—your survival depends on the collective adaptation and shared insights of your crew.

The discovery of this Martian underground world presents both an unprecedented opportunity for exploration and a significant challenge. The successful completion of this mission will not only uncover the fate of the missing pioneer team but also pave the way for future expeditions into this hidden Martian realm. Adapt through either scientific or biological means to survive.

data.short_description: Blind Descent is an open-world survival adventure into the mysteries of the Martian depths. Play solo or with friends in 4-player co-op as you search for the missing team. Adapt to survive by building custom tools, upgrading your base, and/or mutating in this bizarre alien world.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX12 Compatible GPU with 2 GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: i5 or higher
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX12 Compatible GPU with 6 GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
